title: Class 6 UAP shuts down three systems after a directed-energy weapon is aimed at it
summary: Skywatcher tells of Class 6 UAP shuts down three systems after a directed-energy weapon is aimed at it, about c. 2003 (as stated) at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Western United States, hilltop at a government event

tellings.quote: Somewhere around 2003 we spent the year west, and we had opportunity to bring for a government event energy weapon.
